envelope.description: Store: doc_summary_carry, the in-transaction conditional write and the carry write-back

body.title: Store: doc_summary_carry, the in-transaction conditional write and the carry write-back
body.summary: Add the docSummaryCarry field to GraphStore and open doc_summary_carry beside doc_summary (src/db/graph/store.ts:301, :624-625), key repoId u32 BE || UTF-8 entity id, value encodeDocSummary. In src/db/doc-summaries.ts factor writeDocSummaryIfCurrent's body into writeDocSummaryIfCurrentInTxn(s, entityId, summary, { onlyIfAbsent?, keepGoodSummary? }) taking the repo id from the stored entity row; declare the two public overloads so the no-options call keeps Promise<DocSummaryWriteOutcome>; add restoreCarriedDocSummaries(repo), which writes back the repository's carry rows in batches of 500 per write transaction, removing each carry row in the same transaction as its outcome.
acceptanceChecks: A store opened from an existing v5 file gains an empty doc_summary_carry and SCHEMA_VERSION stays 5.
writeDocSummaryIfCurrent without options returns exactly 'written' | 'entity-gone' | 'body-changed' as before (existing tests unchanged).
onlyIfAbsent leaves a stored summary in place ('already-present'); keepGoodSummary leaves a stored summary with no errorCode and the same contentHash in place ('kept-good').

restoreCarriedDocSummaries writes a carried summary whose document body still hashes to its contentHash under the document's current entity number, counts entity-gone and body-changed rows, and leaves no carry row for the repository.

tests.name: src/db/__tests__/doc-summary-carry.test.ts: 'writeDocSummaryIfCurrent is unchanged and onlyIfAbsent never replaces a stored summary'
src/db/__tests__/doc-summary-carry.test.ts: 'keepGoodSummary keeps a stored summary with no errorCode and the same contentHash, and writes over an error row or a different hash'
src/db/__tests__/doc-summary-carry.test.ts: 'restoreCarriedDocSummaries writes a current carried summary under the new entity number, drops gone and changed ones and leaves no carry row'
src/db/__tests__/doc-summary-carry.test.ts: 'a v5 store opened with this build has an empty doc_summary_carry and schema version 5'
